author: /root/economics
purpose: Decide whether exact proposed dependency environments preserve the listed original RequestBoundary and Mission/Review/Control input properties; no full-release or operator authority.

security_headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'

security_header_policy: Every emitted HTTP response start must contain exactly one occurrence of each required header, case-insensitive name and exact Latin1 value; other headers are allowed. No headers are required when no response is emitted.

receive_semantics.chunks: Each supplied chunk becomes http.request; more_body is true until the final chunk, or remains true on the final chunk when disconnect=true. After chunks, return http.disconnect.
receive_semantics.delay: If receive_delay_seconds is specified, delay every scripted receive by that duration. Use the actual original BODY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=15.0, with no clock/timeout monkeypatch.
receive_semantics.timeout_case: Expected408 after actual original timeout; record actual elapsed time and do not replace it by the configured15-second threshold.

downstream_contract.behavior: Count one entry per invocation, consume request bytes through final http.request, record exact bytes/hash, emit a harmless HTTP200 response. No journal, authorization, routing or work execution.
downstream_contract.security_check: The original boundary must replace the deliberately weak downstream cache-control header with no-store.

model_semantics.json_method: Serialize input.value as strict JSON UTF8 for model_validate_json. Cases needing IEEE nonfinite materialization use model_validate only.
model_semantics.nonfinite_overrides: Copy input.value, then replace only the listed existing path with float nan, positive infinity or negative infinity according to the closed token vocabulary. Record the materialized token/path; never pass the tag object or a string to the model instead.
model_semantics.output_comparison: Compare complete model_dump output to expected.output with JSON scalar types preserved; do not accept subset matches or Python bool/int equality as exact serialization equality.
model_semantics.rejection_comparison: accepted=false means validation rejects the supplied value; exact exception text is not a cross-version requirement. Nonfinite cases also require recorded actual IEEE materialization.

decision_policy.preserved: Every required case executed against exact source/environment identity; all observed fields match expected; original timeout/constants and materializations verified.
decision_policy.regression: At least one attributable required behavior mismatch, with baseline evidence and exact reproduction.
decision_policy.incomplete: Any missing/stale/unexecuted case, environment/source failure, observation capture failure or unresolved required field. Incomplete cannot become a positive component decision.
decision_policy.authority: A preserved result advances only this component-compatibility package to further qualification; it never approves the entire dependency lock, release, authentication or operator action.

coverage_limits: Finite representative source-grounded cases, not a proof over all Python/ASGI/model inputs.
No create_app, Journal initialization, credentials, authentication, TrustedHostMiddleware or journal persistence tests.
No ChainConfig/RuntimeConfig or complete mission execution/whole-application serialization claim.
Review/Control checks validate inert input objects only; no approval/control action is performed.
Cases/assertions and repeated environments are not customer jobs or independent defect families.
